active_mainline.next_required_action: Obtain a source-owned microscopic dynamics owner, common-core compatibility, and a cutoff-volume-lattice-uniform estimate before expanding finite variants.

authority: Pointer-only routing contract for preventing auxiliary finite work from displacing the active TECT proof obligation

baseline.note: Counters start at the cutover record and are derived from later control records; pre-cutover results are preserved but are not retroactively scored.

AUXILIARY_SUPPORT.description: Reusable finite, conditional, provenance, or parallel-lane support that does not strengthen the active mainline scope.
AUXILIARY_SUPPORT.required_signal: No active-gate change and no declared scope strengthening.

MAINLINE_ADVANCE.description: New evidence removes a named assumption, strengthens scope, or changes the active gate.
MAINLINE_ADVANCE.required_signal: At least one of gate_changed, scope_strengthened, or new_input_hash is true.

NEGATIVE_RESULT.description: A reproducible failure or falsifier; mainline relevance is explicit in the record.
NEGATIVE_RESULT.required_signal: falsifier_fired or a named route boundary is recorded.

NO_PROGRESS.description: More examples, sizes, or parameters without stronger scope, a gate change, or a new falsifier.

review_policy.note: A threshold triggers a deliberative review, not an automatic scientific stop. The review must name the evidence target and the condition for revisiting the decision.

protected_actions: Claim, tier, and scientific-gate status changes remain operator-authorized.
Physical identity, continuum, QFT, Yang-Mills, or empirical claims are never auto-approved.
Research admission may be auto-approved only with provenance, exact scope, falsifier, and next action.
